prompt_inputs.goal: Prepare for marathon race day with optimized carbohydrate and calorie intake timed around a 15km training run scheduled for 10am

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with 3+ meals and snacks appropriately timed before, during, and after the 10am training run
Total daily calories and carbohydrate intake reflect elevated endurance athlete requirements (approximately 3000+ calories, 8-10g carbs per kg body weight)
All meals and snacks comply with vegetarian and lactose-free restrictions
Plan is concise and presented in a compact format suitable for quick reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring elevated calorie and carbohydrate intake with specific timing around training windows

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize muscle gain and strength recovery from weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers exactly 1 day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
Protein distributed across all meals (minimum 25g per meal) totaling 150+ grams daily
Includes recovery-focused nutrition (carbs post-workout, casein/slow-digesting protein for overnight recovery)
Concise format with clear meal times and portion sizes
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution and recovery nutrition with minimal cardio considerations

prompt_inputs.goal: Lose 3 kg over 2 weeks while maintaining boxing performance and strength

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals for 1 day with realistic portion sizes appropriate for weight loss while supporting athletic performance
Total daily calories support the weight loss goal (approximately 2000-2200 kcal for a 178cm, 75kg male boxer)
All meals are vegetarian and dairy-free
Plan includes adequate protein (minimum 1.2g per kg body weight) for strength maintenance during weight cut
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport requiring weight management (boxer or wrestler) needing a balanced plan that maintains performance while meeting specific caloric or weight targets
